item.tib: snyan rgyud 'bring po sor bzhag gi sngon 'gro
item.coloph: 'di dag rgyud pa'i khungs ni sangs rgyas dgu la thugs/ leb rgan nyag thag lta bu'i thugs kyi dgongs pa la/ 7 nyi shu rtsa bzhi bla ma shel 'phreng ltar brgyud/ las can rnam gnyis gzhon nur sprul nas btul/ dran pas 'phrad gsungs ta pi hri tsa bas/ gzhon nur sprul nas las can rnam gnyin (gnyis) ni/ l-igs sbyor gsal bstan rding gi gdams pas btul/ bla ma grub thob bcu n-i bab chen drug las 'das/ u0f38 drin chen bla ma gsum ni bka' drin rab tu che/ khyed kyi snyan ngag thugs kyi nges don gsal ba'i sgron/ 7 yang rtse snying khu lta spyod kun gyi yang phug 'di/ nga men gzhan la med pas ba dan phyogs bcur khyab par shog ces rgyud khungs kyi tshigs su bkod pa ste/ 7 de ltar bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo snyan rgyud 'di/ drin can bla mas dkar chag btab pa'o/ bdag gis snod dang ldan pa'i sras dang dbon po la/ tshig don gnyis ka rdzogs par byin pa 'di/ chud gsan nam mi gsan khyod rang shes/ rdzogs so//
